en: Black‑and‑white image of a low, wide, single‑storey villa or manor house with a tiled hipped roof and a circular attic window in the center. The building has several evenly spaced rectangular windows and small shrubs planted along the façade. In front there is a circular gravel driveway with a small planted bed in the middle, flanked by large mature trees at the sides. The image has the tonal quality and framing typical of an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcard or architectural photograph. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.
